IMPLEMENTED, test-first (shown RED, then GREEN): (1) EPOCH_BOUNDARIES = {deepseek-v4-pro: [2026-08-18], deepseek-v4-flash: [2026-08-18]} mirrors the recorded fact; a registry-parity control in the regression (arm n) pins the mirror to the registry sentence 'every deepseek-v4-* observation before 2026-08-18', so a registry bump fails the control and forces the table update.
